crossRefs.note: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
“However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

translations.web: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
translations.bsb: Listen carefully to my words; let my declaration ring in your ears.
translations.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
translations.asv: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.
